finalists.label: Mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of the liver
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including a well-defined, low-density, heterogeneous, multilocular cystic tumor and FDG uptake in the solid components of the cyst.

finalists.label: Cholangiocarcinoma
finalists.why: It has several findings that suggest a liver tumor, including elevated alkaline phosphatase and gamma-glutamyl transferase levels, and a well-defined, low-density, heterogeneous, multilocular cystic tumor on CT.

finalists.label: Biliary Cystadenoma
finalists.why: It has a finding that suggests a cystic tumor, including a well-defined, low-density, heterogeneous, multilocular cystic tumor on CT, although it lacks the FDG uptake finding.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and decisive findings, including a well-defined, low-density, heterogeneous, multilocular cystic tumor and FDG uptake in the solid components of the cyst, which suggests a malignant tumor.
